subgoals.goal_name: Explain the AI model

actions.label: Encryption
actions.definition: Encrypting the model’s code, training data, and other sensitive information can prevent attackers from being able to access and steal the model.

actions.label: Model Obfuscation
actions.definition: Obfuscating the model’s code and making it difficult to reverse engineer can prevent attackers from being able to steal the model.

subgoals.goal_name: Validate the AI model

actions.label: Validate ML Model
actions.definition: Validate that machine learning models perform as intended by testing for backdoor triggers or adversarial bias. Monitor model for concept drift and training data drift, which may indicate data tampering and poisoning.

subgoals.goal_name: Document the AI model
Interpret output within context

actions.label: Deploy advanced verification mechanisms
actions.definition: Deploy advanced content verification mechanisms, such as digital signatures and trusted identity frameworks, to ensure the authenticity of content and identities, preventing AI systems from making decisions based on spoofed or false data.

actions.label: Anomaly detection
actions.definition: Sign models and code, apply anomaly detection, and monitor.

subgoals.control_name: Privacy risk of the AI system is examined and documented.

subgoals.goal_name: Examine privacy risk of the AI system

actions.label: Encrypt Sensitive Information
actions.definition: Encrypt sensitive data such as ML models to protect against adversaries attempting to access sensitive data.

actions.label: Encryption
actions.definition: Encrypting the model’s code, training data, and other sensitive information can prevent attackers from being able to access and steal the model.

actions.label: Reducing the training data
actions.definition: Reducing the size of the training dataset or removing redundant or highly correlated features can help reduce the information an attacker can gain from a membership inference attack.

subgoals.goal_name: Document privacy risk of the AI system
